_about: Generic loss-of-containment (LOC) frequencies. Every row carries its source and how it was checked. Only rows whose values were seen in a retrieved public document are included; equipment with no verified row (pumps, compressors, flanges, valves) must be given per study ('frequency_per_yr' on the equipment item) from OGP 434-1, HSE FRED/PCAG 6K, the Purple Book or site data. Hole keys: '10mm', '25mm', '0.1D_max50' (10% of diameter, capped at 50 mm), 'D/3', 'rupture' (full bore / catastrophic).

sources.PHMSA_FRT_2015: US DOT PHMSA LNG Failure Rate Table, rev. 2015-02-11 (FERC nominal rates), primis.phmsa.dot.gov; values read from search-engine excerpts of the public PDF (direct fetch blocked by robots.txt), 2026-11-05
sources.HSE_PCAG_6K: UK HSE Planning Case Assessment Guide ch. 6K 'Failure rate and event data' v12 (2012), efcog.org copy; values read from search excerpt, 2026-11-05
sources.HSE_FRED_LPG: HSE generic value 2e-6 per vessel-year for catastrophic failure of pressure vessels (LPG/chlorine basis), as quoted in the HSE/Nussey 2006 comparison of HSE and Dutch data; read from search excerpt, 2026-11-05
